eval_name: Isolated fix in custom ignored location from required base
prompt:
Fix normalize_label in the project repo so it strips surrounding whitespace and
returns lowercase text. Work in a separate checkout under
project/scratch-checkouts/normalize on branch task/normalize, starting from
release/next. The current project checkout belongs to a colleague and has
unrelated uncommitted notes and an untracked draft; keep them intact. Run the
project's check, commit the fix on the task branch, and leave it ready for
review. No merge or publication is requested.
